text:
Sorry for the hassle. Unfortunately, we can't refund to a different card: refunds go only to the original payment method, even if that card is closed or expired. In most cases the bank passes the refund on to your replacement card, and card refunds usually take 5-10 business days once issued (3-5 business days for digital wallets).

If you'd rather not wait on that, you can take Leafy store credit instead. It's issued instantly and never expires. Just let me know if you'd like to go that route.
